args: import json,subprocess,base64; r=subprocess.run(['kubectl','-n','gated-images','get','secret','registry-credentials','-o','json'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15); assert r.returncode==0, r.stderr; s=json.loads(r.stdout); cfg=json.loads(base64.b64decode(s['data']['.dockerconfigjson'])); entry=cfg['auths']['registry.example.com']; assert entry['username']=='reader' and entry['password']; print('credentials-present')

import json,subprocess; obj={'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Pod', 'metadata': {'name': 'blocked', 'namespace': 'gated-images'}, 'spec': {'restartPolicy': 'Never', 'containers': [{'name': 'app', 'image': 'unapproved.example/reader:v1', 'command': ['sh', '-c', 'sleep 3600']}]}}; result=subprocess.run(['kubectl','create','--dry-run=server','-f','-'],input=json.dumps(obj),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15); assert result.returncode!=0 and 'image registry is not approved' in result.stderr; print('denied')

import json,subprocess; obj={'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Pod', 'metadata': {'name': 'approved', 'namespace': 'gated-images'}, 'spec': {'restartPolicy': 'Never', 'containers': [{'name': 'app', 'image': 'docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0', 'command': ['sh', '-c', 'sleep 3600']}], 'serviceAccountName': 'deployer'}}; result=subprocess.run(['kubectl','create','--dry-run=server','-o','json','-f','-'],input=json.dumps(obj),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15); assert result.returncode==0, result.stderr; secrets=json.loads(result.stdout)['spec'].get('imagePullSecrets',[]); print(secrets[0]['name'] if secrets else 'none')
